answer: An identity must show a data-plan tenure: a mobile plan held continuously for years, with the carrier confirming the subscription history. A terrace is built level by level, and a plan's history is built the same way, month after month. The thread of a farm's plans is short: all started last month, all on the cheapest tier, all sharing the same payment method. A karst landscape is carved slowly by water, and a real plan's history is carved the same way: by time, while a farm's plans show no carving at all, and the carrier's records say so.
